svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 04/12 The Gliderport (Uncommon)
svg.desc: The sea breeze hits the cliffs and lifts straight up. Bright wings hang there like kites. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
